title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 078
review_goal: Differentiate plugin, presentation, and qrcode variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Angled connector block with one cable shape entering from the lower left and one plug head facing right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more dynamic connector piece with an obvious cable feed and angled head.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the centered plugin block when the shape should stay symmetrical with two top prongs.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tilts the connector and adds a visible cable style segment feeding into the plug body.

items.depicts_observation: Presentation screen on one stand showing four vertical bars growing from left to right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a presentation screen that clearly shows vertical bar columns on the slide.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the presentation with a diagonal chart path when the slide should read as bars instead of a trend line.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a board on a stand with four distinct vertical bars inside the frame.

items.depicts_observation: Presentation screen on one stand showing one rising diagonal chart path across the slide
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a presentation screen focused on a rising trend or line chart path.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bar chart presentation when the slide should be read as separate vertical columns.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the bar pattern with one connected chart path climbing across the screen.

items.depicts_observation: Blank hanging presentation screen above one tripod style stand with no chart marks inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain presentation screen shape without any chart content inside it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the chart screens when the slide should contain bars or a rising chart path.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot strips the inner chart marks and leaves a hanging screen frame above a stand.

items.depicts_observation: Square QR code with three large finder boxes at the top left top right and bottom left corners
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic QR code pattern with the usual three large corner finder boxes.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stylized QR code when the corner blocks should look more open and simplified.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot follows the standard QR layout with three prominent corner boxes and dense inner code blocks.
